'''''The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars'''''<ref name="Booklet" /> is a small booklet released with the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Seasons 1-5 Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Seasons 1-5 Collector's Edition]] home release on [[October 15]], [[2013]]. It contains 54 pages of concept art from [[The Clone Wars: Season One|seasons one]] through [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|five]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated television series<ref name="SW.com" /> and a short foreword by the series' Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]].<ref name="Booklet" />
